brief: Members: Cenomi Centers' Q3 profit fell 19% to SAR 404.9m because the year-earlier quarter included an insurance settlement, while revenue rose 10% to SAR 606.2m in its first quarter with Westfield Jeddah in operation (Saudi Exchange filing via Mubasher; Argaam).

Knowledge Economic City's Q3 profit rose to SAR 99.7m from SAR 28.2m on home sales, a July land sale and a new hotel, a week before its 15 Nov vote on becoming Al-Jiwar Economic City (Argaam; Arab News).
UAE dining: DEAL Holdings' FAB Group plans at least 25 food and beverage sites in the UAE over five years, starting with London's Kricket at Vida Emirates Hills (Retail ME, 9 Nov).

Service and payments: Egypt's central bank has set rules for banking agents that require complaint notices and fee disclosure (9 Nov), and in Bahrain CrediMax will explore AI shopping agents for merchants with Mastercard (4 Nov).

Also new to the site: Korea Town by Boutiqaat has opened two Qatar stores, at Mall of Qatar and Place Vendôme (2 Nov), and Zalando has launched an AI agent that buys from other retailers inside its app (3 Nov).

findings.title: Cenomi Centers' Q3 profit falls 19% to SAR 404.9m against a year-earlier insurance gain, as revenue rises 10% to SAR 606.2m
findings.summary: Cenomi Centers' Q3 2026 revenue rose to SAR 606.2m from SAR 551.3m, while net profit attributable to shareholders fell to SAR 404.9m from SAR 500.7m, because the year-earlier quarter included the full and final settlement of an insurance claim for a fire at one of its assets. Nine-month revenue rose 1.9% to SAR 1,758.1m and nine-month attributable profit fell to SAR 993.1m from SAR 1,190.5m. The company says Westfield Jeddah, in its operational phase since 30 Jul 2026, made its first revenue contribution in the quarter.
findings.why: Cenomi is a member, and these are its first results with Westfield Jeddah in operation, a month before RCM Jeddah (7 to 8 Dec).

sources.outlet: Mubasher (copy of the Saudi Exchange disclosure)

findings.title: DEAL Holdings' FAB Group plans at least 25 UAE food and beverage sites in five years, starting with London's Kricket in Dubai
findings.summary: FAB Group, the food and beverage business through which DEAL Holdings is moving into hospitality, plans at least 25 F&B locations across the UAE over the next five years, Retail ME reports. It holds the GCC development rights for London's Kricket, whose first regional restaurant is planned at Vida Emirates Hills in Dubai, and is targeting the first quarter of 2027 to announce a second UAE location. Saudi Arabia is named as an important market; no mall sites have been announced.
findings.why: A new multi-concept dining operator with a five-year UAE pipeline and GCC franchise rights is a leasing prospect for malls and community centres building their food and beverage offer.

findings.title: Egypt's central bank sets rules for banks' use of agents, including complaint notices and fee disclosure
findings.summary: The Central Bank of Egypt has approved rules on how banks may use banking agents, which, once approved by the CBE, can identify and verify customers and update their information on a bank's behalf. Agency contracts may run for no more than three years, with the CBE told at least three months before expiry. Agents must display how customers can complain at their premises, state the fees and commissions charged and the days and hours services are available, and pass documents to the bank within 30 working days. Eligible agents include non-bank institutions supervised by the Financial Regulatory Authority, government bodies and Egyptian missions abroad, and the CBE presents the rules as part of its financial inclusion drive.
findings.why: Egypt now sets service duties, including complaint notices and fee and hours disclosure, for third parties that serve bank customers, a reference point for customer-service standards in Egyptian retail and banking.

findings.title: Knowledge Economic City's Q3 profit rises to SAR 99.7m from SAR 28.2m on home sales, a July land sale and a new hotel
findings.summary: Knowledge Economic City's Q3 2026 revenue rose 98.8% to SAR 245.1m and its net profit to SAR 99.7m from SAR 28.2m a year earlier, according to its Saudi Exchange filing as reported by Argaam and Arab News. Both cite stronger residential sales after the new Non-Saudi Property Ownership Law, SAR 169.6m from a land sale in July and a contribution from its newly opened hotel, which is not named. Nine-month revenue rose 40.2% to SAR 330.5m, and the company swung to a nine-month net profit of SAR 71.3m from a loss of SAR 26.7m.
findings.why: KEC is a member and the developer of Multaqa AlMadinah; the results come a week before shareholders vote on 15 Nov on renaming it Al-Jiwar Economic City.

findings.title: CrediMax and Mastercard to explore AI shopping agents for Bahrain's merchants
findings.summary: Bahrain payments provider CrediMax will explore agentic commerce with Mastercard for merchants across the Kingdom, Mastercard announced on 4 Nov 2026. The initial focus is Mastercard's Agent Suite for Merchants, which brings AI-powered shopping into merchants' own online stores, delivered through Mastercard Merchant Cloud with Mastercard Gateway handling payments. No merchants, timeline or figures were given.
findings.why: A Gulf payments provider is preparing merchants, mall retailers among them, to run their own AI shopping agents; the work is exploratory and sets no rules for outside agents.

findings.title: Zalando launches an AI shopping agent that can buy from other retailers inside its app
findings.summary: Zalando has unveiled its first AI shopping agent, which lets customers buy products from other retailers through the Zalando app, Reuters reported on 3 Nov 2026. Zalando plans AI-assisted checkout on its Zalando Extended platform in 2027, and a pilot with home furnishings retailer Westwing is under way. The report does not say which markets the agent covers.
findings.why: A large fashion platform is turning its app into an agent that buys across other retailers' ranges, a model that Gulf marketplaces, retailers and mall apps may need to answer.

findings.entity: Korea Town by Boutiqaat (Mall of Qatar; Place Vendôme)
findings.title: Korea Town by Boutiqaat opens two Qatar stores, at Mall of Qatar and Place Vendôme
findings.summary: Boutiqaat Group's K-beauty store concept Korea Town has opened two stores in Qatar, at Mall of Qatar and Place Vendôme, according to the group's release of 2 Nov 2026 (dateline Hawally, Kuwait). Korea Town now trades in Kuwait, Bahrain, where its first store outside Kuwait opened at The Avenues Bahrain, and Qatar, as well as online through the Boutiqaat app. The release gives no opening dates or store sizes and says further openings are planned across the GCC.
findings.why: A member's beauty concept is taking space in two large Qatar malls and plans more GCC openings that landlords can court.

sources.outlet: Boutiqaat Group (press release via PR Newswire)
